message.content:
**Short answer:** Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. The city’s police department and code‑enforcement offices handle most noise‑related issues, and you can also reach out to your local city council member if you’d like a more direct line of communication. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where / How | |------|------------|-------------| | **1. Identify the type of noise** | • Residential or commercial
• Daytime vs. nighttime
• Persistent vs. one‑off | • Helps the police determine priority | | **2. Gather details** | • Date & time of the disturbance
• Exact location (address or intersection)
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs) | • Keep a written log if possible | | **3. Contact the Atlanta Police Department (APD)** | • **Noise Enforcement Unit** (the APD’s “Noise” division) | • Phone: **404‑656‑4000** (24 h)
• Online: [APD Noise Complaint Form](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/police/noise-enforcement) | | **4. Use the 311 Service** | • 311 is Atlanta’s non‑emergency city service line. | • Phone: **404‑656‑3111**
• Online: [311 Atlanta](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311) | | **5. File a formal complaint with the City’s Code Enforcement** | • For ongoing or repeated violations (e.g., construction noise, illegal parties). | • Phone: **404‑656‑4000** (same as APD)
• Online: [City of Atlanta Code Enforcement](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/code-enforcement) | | **6. Reach out to your City Council Member** | • If you want a council member to advocate on your behalf or if the issue isn’t resolved quickly. | • Find your council member:
 • Visit the [City Council page](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/city-council)
 • Email or call the member’s office (contact info on the page). | | **7. Follow up** | • Keep a record of your complaint ID (if given).
• If the noise persists, call back or submit a new complaint. | • The APD typically responds within 24–48 hrs for serious violations. | --- ## Quick Links | Resource | Link | |----------|------| | **Atlanta Police Department – Noise Enforcement** | | | **311 Atlanta** | | | **City of Atlanta – Code Enforcement** | | | **City Council Contact Page** | | --- ### A Few Tips 1. **Timing matters** – Noise complaints are taken more seriously during nighttime hours (typically 10 p.m.–6 a.m.) when the city’s noise ordinance is stricter. 2. **Document everything** – Photos, videos, or audio recordings (if legal in your area) can help the police assess the situation. 3. **Be polite but firm** – The officers are more likely to act quickly if you’re respectful and clear about the problem. 4. **Know the ordinance** – Atlanta’s noise ordinance is available on the city website; it lists prohibited noise levels and times. Familiarizing yourself with it can strengthen your case. --- **Bottom line:** If you’re experiencing unwanted noise in Atlanta, you can file a complaint through the city’s police department, 311, or code enforcement. If you prefer a more direct line to city leadership, contact your local council member. The city has clear procedures and resources to help residents keep their neighborhoods peaceful.
